_doc: M31 school behaviour records, keyed by the creature maker's species id (cage.json 'species'). Anatomy stays in the maker's record; body length comes from the fish glb. Values in BL, BL/s, s unless the key ends in _m (metres) or _deg. 'base' names a preset from the Nov 1 schooling paper (papers/systems/schooling/, Table 1 + presets). bl_m_standin is used only until the glb lands. Every number cites its source in 'src'.

open.src: schoollab_v87 PRESETS open (paper open preset + alarm v1); REF P 0.965, NND 0.80 BL, speed 1.91 BL/s

lagoon.src: schoollab_v87 PRESETS lagoon; REF P 0.59, NND 1.02 BL, speed 0.39 BL/s; No. 22 film P 0.5-0.6, 0.3-0.5 BL/s

mill.src: research/schooling/school.py PRESETS mill (bigeye trevally daytime mill, Holland et al. 1996); M 0.88

trevally.src: jack mackerel / mackerel NND 1.43-1.51 BL (Pitcher & Partridge 1979, paper Table 1); cruise ~1.1-1.5 BL/s (anthias / jacks, No. 22); FID stand-in 2.5 m (reef fish FID 1-4 m to divers, Gotanda et al. 2009)

lagoon_baitfish.src: key frame v4 (120 fish at 12 cm over the rock); lagoon wall preset. STAND-IN species id until the maker names one

open_scad.src: paper open preset (scad / sardine / herring), NND 0.82 BL herring
